mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board ( boardType, category, memberIdx, title, content ) VALUES ( #{boardType}, #{category}, #{memberIdx}, #{title}, #{content} )
mapper.select: SELECT boardIdx, boardType, category, memberIdx, title, content, viewCount, createdAt, updatedAt FROM board WHERE boardIdx = #{boardIdx}
mapper.update: UPDATE board SET category = #{category}, title = #{title}, content = #{content}, updatedAt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE boardIdx = #{boardIdx} AND memberIdx = #{memberIdx}
